name: Torrejoncillo (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over green with a blue triangle at the hoist, charged towards the fly with the crowned municipal arms of Torrejoncillo (a lion and a tower).
history: The flag of Torrejoncillo was approved on 14 July 1987 and is described as two trapezoids symmetrical about the longitudinal axis of the flag with a triangle whose apex lies at the exact centre, with the arms of the municipality (approved 23 October 1986) embroidered at the centre.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
